description: This file contains functions and logic for managing and repairing gateway services, including cleanup of legacy services, configuration validation, and installation plans within a Node.js environment.

methods.name: detectGatewayRuntime
methods.description: Determines the runtime environment (bun or node) based on the first program argument.

methods.name: findGatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Finds the executable path preceding the 'gateway' argument in the program arguments.

methods.name: normalizeExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the executable path, handling symlinks.

methods.name: extractDetailPath
methods.description: Extracts a specific detail path from a string if it starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: cleanupLegacyLaunchdService
methods.description: Removes a legacy launchd service on macOS and moves its plist to Trash.

methods.name: classifyLegacyServices
methods.description: Classifies legacy services by platform and scope, identifying failed classifications.

methods.name: cleanupLegacyDarwinServices
methods.description: Cleans up legacy launchd services on macOS.

methods.name: cleanupLegacyLinuxUserServices
methods.description: Removes legacy systemd services on Linux.

methods.name: maybeRepairGatewayServiceConfig
methods.description: Validates and repairs the gateway service configuration, including token and entrypoint consistency, and optionally updates the service.

methods.name: maybeScanExtraGatewayServices
methods.description: Detects extra gateway-like services, cleans up legacy ones, and provides recommendations.
